hooks.command: [ -f .claude/gate-off ] && exit 0; f=$(sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1); if [ -z "$f" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: approval hook could not parse the tool payload, so it cannot verify this edit is covered by an approved spec. Failing closed. Report at https://github.com/trackmind-ai/sdlc-atlas/issues"; exit 2; fi; case "$f" in */.claude/*|*/docs/*|*/designs/*|*knowledge.md|*README*|*.gitignore|*CHANGELOG*) exit 0;; *) [ -f .claude/memory/approvals/ACTIVE ] || { echo "BLOCKED: no approved spec. Production-code edits require an approval marker (.claude/memory/approvals/ACTIVE). Run /approve-spec, approve a /fix, or confirm /bootstrap. Escape hatch for non-pipeline work: touch .claude/gate-off (visible in git status)."; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0
